report.summary: Chunk 9/10 of vendors.py: defines OllamaLocalAdapter class with budget enforcement and dispatch, plus VendorAvailability dataclass and available_vendors function stub.
risks: OllamaLocalAdapter.__init__ | low | self.local computed from lane_for_host(self.host) but self.host may be set after super().__init__? Actually set before super().__init__, so fine. | Verify that lane_for_host is deterministic and does not rely on mutable state.

OllamaLocalAdapter._dispatch | medium | Uses effective_input_window() and num_ctx_value() without imports shown; assumes they are available. If not imported, NameError at runtime. | Check that these functions are imported in the module.
available_vendors | medium | Function stub ends mid-definition; missing return statement and closing. | Ensure function is completed in next chunk.
todos: Verify imports for effective_input_window, num_ctx_value, count_tokens, ProviderHTTPError, native_chat, lane_for_host, model_family.

claims.text: loopback only, the same predicate that decides the egress lane, so the two cannot disagree about one host.
claims.why: Refers to a predicate and egress lane logic not present in this chunk.

claims.text: The bench is another machine on the tailnet, and bytes sent there have left this one.
claims.why: Refers to a 'bench' concept not defined in this chunk.
_dispatch returns error dict with 'over_context_budget' reason when tokens > window.

claims.text: Ollama HEAD-truncates an over-long prompt -- it eats the system prompt first -- so a silently truncated council turn is a reviewer that never saw the question it is answering.
claims.why: Describes external behavior of Ollama; not verifiable from this code.

claims.text: The budget is ``_ollama_native.effective_input_window()`` (full ``num_ctx`` minus the generation reserve), reused rather than reinvented.
claims.why: _dispatch calls effective_input_window() (with optional reserve) to compute window.

claims.text: ONE predicate, shared with the egress gate it feeds. Not a local copy: ``local`` and ``lane`` must never be able to disagree about the same host, and they did (``[::1]`` was local-but-untrusted).
claims.why: Refers to egress gate logic not present in this chunk.

claims.text: Deliberately NOT keyed on host: local 7b and bench 7b are the same weights, so they must collide as one class.
claims.why: Property returns ('local', model_family(self.model)), not including host.

claims.text: Cheap probe result.  No model is invoked to produce this.
claims.why: Dataclass fields are all metadata; no invocation in its definition.

claims.text: Does the binary exist; does the Ollama host answer ``/api/version``.  No model is invoked, no prompt is sent, nothing is billed.
claims.why: Function body is incomplete; no implementation of probes in this chunk.

claims.text: ``agy`` is reported unavailable until an operator asserts sign-in: the only way to test its auth is to call it, and a probe that calls a model is not a probe.
claims.why: No agy-related code in this chunk.

claims.text: Both callables are injectable so a test can establish availability with no CLI on PATH and no network.

observations.what: OllamaLocalAdapter._dispatch uses effective_input_window and num_ctx_value without imports visible in chunk.
available_vendors function is incomplete; ends mid-definition after first append.
OllamaLocalAdapter.independence_class uses model_family(self.model) but self.model is not set in __init__; likely inherited from parent.
Docstring claims 'loopback only' but no check restricts host to loopback; host parameter defaults to DEFAULT_BENCH_OLLAMA_HOST which may not be loopback.
